en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit
Bas...ket...ball?
Sorry... Gonta not know what that is...
Does...Shuichi mean breadbasket?

Gentleman no can take off fancy clothes!
Especially not here!

Maybe Shuichi have detective reason
for getting undressed, but...
Gonta...no can take clothes off here...

Good idea. No wanna pull muscle.
That be bad.
Allow Gonta to crack back for you!

Don't worry! Shuichi will be okay!
Gonta is natural back-cracker!

Gonta not break Shuichi!
Just Shuichi's back!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta lifted me in his giant arms...
and cracked my back with delicate grace.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Gonta's inner thoughts...?
